Data:Agave.aeterna.json.Label: Agave Aeterna
Data:Agave.aeterna.json.Desc: agave aeterna, the 'history plant', unlike its cousin the century plant, blooms every year. Perhaps it will do so forever.

xexts.scrutiny: Aguamiel sweet as nostalgia's dawn. [A previous librarian was said to sweeten lapsang tea with historied honey from this plant.]

Data:Agdistis.json.label: Mr Peter Agdistis
Data:Agdistis.json.desc: Musician, mystic, impresario. Agdistis was a dancer once. One cannot see him without knowing it. The wound in his thigh keeps him from the stage; but his every movement still has the cadence of a prayer.

xexts.befriend．agdistis．chaima: Agdistis and Chaima have become friends.

Data:Agenda.autarchy.json.label: Agenda: Autarchy
Data:Agenda.autarchy.json.desc: This one thinks it important that humankind - and any Institute that guards it - can survive without the patronage of any Hour.

Data:Agenda.better.gods.json.label: Agenda: Better Gods
Data:Agenda.better.gods.json.desc: This one hopes to build something to substitute for the Hours.

Data:Agenda.corrivality.json.label: Agenda: Corrivality
Data:Agenda.corrivality.json.desc: This one believes that conflict is necessary for the world's sustention.

Data:Agenda.peace.json.label: Agenda: Peace
Data:Agenda.peace.json.desc: This one believes that struggle and war may yet be the cause of the world's immolation.

Data:Agenda.revelation.json.label: Agenda: Revelation
Data:Agenda.revelation.json.desc: This one wishes to share knowledge, despite Calyptra.

Data:Agenda.secrecy.json.label: Agenda: Secrecy
Data:Agenda.secrecy.json.desc: This one is aware of the perils of knowledge and the benefits of Calyptra.

Data:Agenda.stone.consumed.json.label: Agenda: Stone Consumed
Data:Agenda.stone.consumed.json.desc: This one would burn or shatter what remains of the gods-from-stone, to fuel their own purposes.

Data:Agenda.stone.remembered.json.label: Agenda: Stone Remembered
Data:Agenda.stone.remembered.json.desc: This one would recall or preserve something of the gods-from-stone.

Data:Aglaophotis.json.Label: Aglaophotis
Data:Aglaophotis.json.Desc: The rosy colour of good memories; but not the colour of the rose.

xexts.scrutiny: A potent protection in many troubles.

Data:Aladim.json.label: Dr Ibn al-Adim
Data:Aladim.json.desc: 'The Aleppine': Historian, doctor, and above all, traveller. The good doctor has been associated with all but one of the libraries of the Watchman's Tree. He was even Secretary Nunciant of Hush House for a little while, but he has never been on good terms with the Suppression Bureau.

xexts.befriend．aladim．connie: Al-Adim and Connie will see each other after the salon.

Data:Aladim.likes.connie.json.desc: Al-Adim has invited Connie to dine with him in private.

Data:Alembic.sly.json.Label: Sly Alembic
Data:Alembic.sly.json.Desc: A cheeky decanter of wine fortified with unusual influences.

xexts.scrutiny: An oddly satisfying chemical tang overlays the wine-flavours.
